title: selvedge.json
description: Selvedge target configuration: the exact origins the guarded browser may reach and the env hooks a user may approve, and the sign-in check for walled pages. Validated by selvedge/lib/env-config.mjs, whose accepted key sets selvedge/tests/test-env.sh asserts equal to the property names here.

origins.description: Exact origins, each scheme://host[:port] (http or https). Compared as parsed exact strings: no regex, suffix or substring match. A non-local origin (any host other than localhost, 127.0.0.1, [::1]) needs allow_remote.

allow_remote.description: Permit non-local origins in the list.

allow_remote_mutation.description: Permit methods other than GET, HEAD and OPTIONS (POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, PROPFIND, …) to a remote origin.

hooks.description: Shell commands run at the repo root by `selvedge env hook <name>`, only with a user-scoped approval and only while every origin is local.

auth.description: Sign-in for walled pages. `selvedge auth setup` runs the approved auth_setup hook (or, with --headed, lets a human sign in) and keeps the session outside the repo; `selvedge run` loads it and checks signed_in_check once before the first criterion.

env.description: The environment variables the auth_setup hook reads its credentials from. Names only: a value never appears in selvedge.json, and every value is redacted from a run's evidence.

signed_in_check.description: A page on a listed origin and a locator (exactly one plan-step locator form: role, label, text or testid; never CSS or XPath) that matches at least one element only when signed in.
